title: Grateful Dead Live at Unknown on 1967-02-12

ai_review.summary: High‑energy 1967 blues showcase with Smokestack Lightning > King Bee, captured on a decent‑to‑good soundboard tape despite some over‑processing artifacts
ai_review.review: The recording delivers a raw, driving performance centered on Pigpen’s harp and vocals with Jerry Garcia’s sweet early‑era guitar work. While a few reviewers note digital saturation, modulation quirks, and occasional distortion, the consensus is that for a mid‑60s tape this is surprisingly clear and vivid, making the music shine.

ai_rating.rationale: Average rating ≈4.2 from 18 reviews; strong musical praise outweighs mixed technical complaints, giving a solid positive overall assessment.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Generally clear for the era; some listeners report over‑saturation, digital distortion and a ring‑mod like effect on Garcia’s guitar, but most consider it a good tape reproduction of a 1967 live show.

show_quality.setlist_flow: A concise blues set that flows naturally from Smokestack Lightning into King Bee, highlighting Pigpen’s harp and vocals with tight accompaniment.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Praised for sweet early‑era guitar tone; some note a digital ring‑mod artifact but overall his playing is highlighted as strong.
band_member_comments.Bob: Briefly mentioned together with Jerry at the five‑minute mark, no detailed commentary.
